author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
My take away was different. We need more empathy in places of power who might understand why a child in a gang riddled neighborhood might engage in these practices as a way to stay safe.

We need to change our expectations around dumb photos. Adolescents have always dumb stupid stuff. Now they do dumb stuff with cameras in their pocket.
